title: Beyond Expected Value: PPO with Distributional Critics for Systematic Conservation Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32948v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Systematic conservation planning must allocate limited protection budgets sequentially under ecological and climatic uncertainty. Static tools cannot adapt as conditions change, and policies optimised only for expected outcomes can fail on the worst-case trajectories climate change makes increasingly likely. CAPTAIN was the first framework to cast this as sequential reinforcement learning, but its gradient-free Evolution Strategies (ES) optimiser lacks per-timestep credit assignment. We replace ES with Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) via a Plackett-Luce solution to CAPTAIN's non-differentiable action space, and replace its scalar critic with an Implicit Quantile Network (IQN) modelling the full return distribution. A matched-granularity comparison shows decision granularity, not the optimiser, drives most of the ecological gain, so the real contribution is training efficiency and extensibility to risk-sensitive objectives. translated_title: 超越期望值：用于系统性保护规划的分布型评论家PPO方法
translated_abstract: 系统性保护规划需要在生态与气候不确定性下顺序分配有限的保护预算。静态工具无法随条件变化进行调整，而仅针对期望结果优化的策略在面对气候变化日益可能引发的最坏情况轨迹时可能失败。CAPTAIN是首个将此问题构建为顺序强化学习的框架，但其无梯度的进化策略（ES）优化器缺乏对每个时间步的信用分配。我们通过Plackett-Luce方案解决了CAPTAIN动作空间不可微的问题，从而用近端策略优化（PPO）取代ES，并用建模完整回报分布的隐式分位数网络（IQN）取代其标量评论家。匹配粒度的对比实验表明，驱动大部分生态收益的是决策粒度而非优化器本身，因此本文的真正贡献在于训练效率以及对风险敏感目标的可扩展性。在新西……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出用PPO结合Plackett-Luce方案以及基于隐式分位数网络（IQN）的分布型评论家来改进CAPTAIN保护规划框架，发现决策粒度而非优化器是生态收益的主要来源，其真正贡献在于更高的训练效率和对风险敏感目标的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper replaces CAPTAIN's Evolution Strategies with PPO via a Plackett-Luce solution and its scalar critic with an Implicit Quantile Network, showing that decision granularity rather than the optimizer drives most ecological gains, with the real contributions being training efficiency and extensibility to risk-sensitive objectives.
